disposition.note: Covered by column added to section 8 mapping each of BR1 to BR10 to an AC and a TC; TC-S1-E4005-CON-05 added for BR9.
BR Field ID column added to section 11; each of the six data rows mapped to its BR rule ID.
MSG-P1-001 text copied from Error and Message Standard v4 wording; the message set is unchanged.
Placeholder kept per BR2 and section 4 step 3; owners publish names before wave 3 tag, and a minor version replaces the placeholder.
Score stays ACE's and is read on rwb-source-data; no table declared; per-route answer held in the decision record only.
Per-route return read from Recommendation.expectedReturnByRoute; the route answer adds no element until a minor version.
BR5 declares no gateway or agent call; live model calls belong to rwb-agent (P10); no direct S1 call is needed.
Rule package and version recorded on each decision (section 11 rows 4 and 6); rule owner named in rwb-decision before wave 3 release.
MSG-P1-001 text now copies the standard wording: 'Today's load has not arrived.'
